label: The Chair of Peter (CATHEDRAE S. PETRI, APOSTOLI, Die 22 februarii)

chants.notes: Engraving continues onto p549 y15-282 with the verse 'Confiteantur Domino misericordiae eius : et mirabilia eius filiis hominum.'
gr_index_entry keys this Alleluia to p549 (where the verse begins), not p550. Verse text finishes at the top of p550 y61.3-81.4 with 'confirma fratres tuos.'

Band also includes the printed psalm-verse plan below the communio: 'Ps. 79*, 2 ab. 9. 10. 11. 12. 15. 16. 18. 19' - a psalm-tone plan for the communion antiphon, not a separate chant and not modeled.
